contract_requirement: Bind prediction, episode, fixture, generation and run identities before evaluator-side benchmark evidence can be treated as provenance-sealed component evidence.
observation: PredictionCandidate accepts caller-supplied benchmark_run_id and benchmark_generation. evaluate_next_observation_prediction does not accept or validate an exact WP800 RunDescriptor, and PredictionEvaluation copies the candidate-supplied benchmark_run_id/generation into evaluator-only evidence.

counterexample.expected_fail_closed_behavior: reject before evaluator evidence is minted because the candidate run identity is not bound to the canonical RunDescriptor
counterexample.observed_behavior: repository test reaches evaluator output carrying the self-attested candidate run identity; the fail-closed assertion therefore fails

recommended_successor_scope: A successor WP803 generation should require evaluator-side exact RunDescriptor input, verify RunDescriptor.assert_matches_fixture(fixture), bind prediction.benchmark_run_id to run.run_id before step_episode, and include run_descriptor_sha256 in evaluator evidence. Preserve the public prediction-construction boundary so hidden fixture/run provenance never becomes policy input.
coordination_note: This record is review-only candidate-falsifier evidence. It does not overwrite the accepted active pointer or mint a successor generation by itself. Generation advance must follow CLAIM_PROTOCOL.md and state-concurrency reconciliation.
